name: Black Bag Limit Exemption
description: Application for exemption to place out additional black bags if recycling all accepted materials.

evidence_requirements.name: Proof of recycling compliance
evidence_requirements.notes: Must show all accepted kerbside materials are recycled

eligibility_criteria.criterion: Producing more than three black bags of non-recyclable waste
No recyclable material in black or exemption bags

clarifying_questions.question: What specific documents are accepted as proof of recycling compliance?
clarifying_questions.why: To clarify what constitutes valid evidence for recycling compliance.

clarifying_questions.question: What factors influence the typical timeline for processing the exemption?
clarifying_questions.why: To understand the variability in processing times.
